author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: The SSR fallback branch is defeated when previousFullPath is omitted.
findings.consequence: A non-client caller that uses the function's advertised fallback path with only fullPath and replace would evaluate the default argument before entering the import.meta.client guard, causing browserFullPath to read window on the server instead of routing through router.push or router.replace.
findings.evidence: navigateRawFullPath declares previousFullPath = browserFullPath() at line 131, while the non-client branch is inside the function body at lines 133-135. Current same-file omitted-argument callers are client dialog-close handlers, so this is a latent boundary defect rather than a demonstrated page failure.
findings.recommendation: Make previousFullPath optional and compute browserFullPath only after the import.meta.client guard, for example use previousFullPath ?? browserFullPath() inside the client-only branch.
